title.value: Randomized Trial of Verubecestat for Prodromal Alzheimer’s Disease
title.quote: Randomized Trial of Verubecestat for Prodromal Alzheimer’s Disease

design.value: randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, parallel group, 104-week trial period
design.quote: The trial consisted of a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, parallel group, 104-week trial period

n.quote: A total of 1454 patients were enrolled

population.value: patients who had memory impairment and elevated brain amyloid levels but whose condition did not meet the case definition of dementia
population.quote: patients who had memory impairment and elevated brain amyloid levels but whose condition did not meet the case definition of dementia.

biomarker_confirmation.value: presence of brain amyloid as gauged by a radiologist’s visual inspection of amyloid-ligand positronemission tomography (PET) imaging
biomarker_confirmation.quote: presence of brain amyloid as gauged by a radiologist’s visual inspection of amyloid-ligand positronemission tomography (PET) imaging.

intervention.value: oral verubecestat at a dose of 12 mg, oral verubecestat at a dose of 40 mg
intervention.quote: oral verubecestat at a dose of 12 mg, oral verubecestat at a dose of 40 mg

n_description.quote: A total of 1454 patients were enrolled

outcomes.name: change from baseline to week 104 in the Clinical Dementia Rating Scale–Sum of Boxes score
outcomes.quote: The estimated mean change from baseline to week 104 in the CDR-SB score was 1.65 in the 12-mg group, 2.02 in the 40-mg group, and 1.58 in the placebo group (P=0.67 for the comparison between the 12-mg group and the placebo group and P=0.01 for the comparison between the 40-mg group and the placebo group), suggesting a worse outcome in the higher-dose group than in the placebo group.
outcomes.effect_estimate: 1.65 in the 12-mg group, 2.02 in the 40-mg group, and 1.58 in the placebo group
outcomes.p_value: P=0.67 for the comparison between the 12-mg group and the placebo group and P=0.01 for the comparison between the 40-mg group and the placebo group
outcomes.prespecification_evidence: The primary efficacy outcome was the change from baseline to week 104 in the Clinical Dementia Rating Scale–Sum of Boxes score

outcomes.name: progression to the diagnosis of dementia due to Alzheimer’s disease
outcomes.quote: The estimated rate of progression to dementia due to Alzheimer’s disease was 24.5, 25.5, and 19.3 events per 100 patient-years in the 12-mg group, the 40-mg group, and the placebo group, respectively (hazard ratio for 40 mg vs. placebo, 1.38; 97.51% confidence interval, 1.07 to 1.79, not adjusted for multiple comparisons), favoring placebo.
outcomes.effect_estimate: hazard ratio for 40 mg vs. placebo, 1.38
outcomes.prespecification_evidence: There were seven secondary outcomes: the progression to the diagnosis of dementia due to Alzheimer’s disease

primary_endpoint_status.quote: The trial was terminated for futility after 1454 patients had been enrolled
primary_endpoint_status.explanation: The trial was stopped early for futility as verubecestat did not improve clinical ratings of dementia on the CDR-SB compared to placebo.

harms.name: death
harms.quote: In part 1 of the trial, there were three deaths in the placebo group, three in the 12-mg group, and one in the 40-mg group

harms.name: amyloid-related imaging abnormalities
harms.quote: verubecestat was not associated with a greater incidence of delirium or amyloid-related imaging abnormalities.

deaths.value: three deaths in the placebo group, three in the 12-mg group, and one in the 40-mg group
deaths.quote: In part 1 of the trial, there were three deaths in the placebo group, three in the 12-mg group, and one in the 40-mg group

serious_adverse_events.value: osteoarthritis, basal-cell carcinoma, squamouscell carcinoma, syncope, and prostate cancer
serious_adverse_events.quote: Serious adverse events that were reported in more than 1% of the patients in at least one trial group in this part of the trial included osteoarthritis, basal-cell carcinoma, squamouscell carcinoma, syncope, and prostate cancer, with similar incidences among the groups.

limitations: Since there were few patients in the substudy of biomarkers in cerebrospinal fluid (five or six patients per group), planned analyses were not performed
These comparisons are exploratory, and the confidence intervals are unadjusted; thus, the strength of any resulting inferences is limited.

multiplicity.approach: Bonferroni approach (splitting the overall α between the two dose levels of verubecestat) in conjunction with a hierarchical sequential testing approach
multiplicity.quote: A Bonferroni approach (splitting the overall α between the two dose levels of verubecestat) in conjunction with a hierarchical sequential testing approach of outcomes was used to control for the type 1 error rate
